```{r}

  
library(readr)

FinalCollegesandUniversities <- read_csv("UniversityData/FinalCollegesandUniversities.csv")

View(BostonTStops)
```

```{r}
#Here is where we still start cleaning 
library(dplyr)

glimpse(Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths)

```
```{r}
summary(Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

#Now cleaning 
Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths <- Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths %>%
  select( -member_casual, -rideable_type) 

#dropping NAs
Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths <- Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths %>%
  drop_na(end_lat, end_lng)

summary(Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths)


```







```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
summary(FinalCollegesandUniversities)


FinalCollegesandUniversities <- FinalCollegesandUniversities %>%
  select(
    -PLUS_FOUR,
    -URL,
    -AWARDSOFFR,
    -DEGREEOFFR,
    -MAIN_TEL,
    -NCES_TYPE,
    -LARGEPROG,
    -L_SRC
  )

FinalCollegesandUniversities$SchoolType_binary <- ifelse(
  FinalCollegesandUniversities$TYPE == "PRI", 1, 0
)

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

FinalCollegesandUniversities <- FinalCollegesandUniversities %>%
  unite(
    col = "University_Name", 
    COLLEGE, CAMPUS,       
    sep = ":"              
  )


summary(FinalCollegesandUniversities)

```


```{r}
summary(BostonTStops)
BostonTStops <- BostonTStops %>%
  select(
    -TERMINUS,       
    -ROUTE,
    -LINE
  )
```

```{r}

library(sf)
library(dplyr) 


```

```{r}
# Convert Universities DF to an SF object 
# Coordinates are in LATITUDE/LONGITUDE columns (EPSG 4326)
CollegesandUniversities_SF <- st_as_sf(FinalCollegesandUniversities, 
                            coords = c("Long", "Lat"), 
                            crs = 4326) %>%
  # Transform to a local projected CRS (Massachusetts State Plane) for accurate distance calc
  st_transform(crs = 2249)

# Convert BlueBike Trips DF to an SF object (assuming common BlueBike column names)
bluebike_trips_sf <- st_as_sf(Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths, 
                              coords = c("start_lng", "start_lat"), 
                              crs = 4326) %>%
  # Transform to the same CRS as the universities
  st_transform(crs = 2249)

```


```{r}

# Find the index of the nearest university for each trip
nearest_university_index <- st_nearest_feature(bluebike_trips_sf, CollegesandUniversities_SF)

# Add the university information back to the trips data frame
# This creates the 'University_Name' column needed for the aggregation step
bluebike_trips_joined <- bluebike_trips_sf %>%
  mutate(
    University_Name = CollegesandUniversities_SF$University_Name[nearest_university_index],
    # Convert back to a standard data frame for easier aggregation/regression later
    # and drop the 'geometry' column if needed
    geometry = NULL
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

```



```{r}
library(dplyr)

rides_per_university_month <- bluebike_trips_joined %>%
  # Create a 'year_month' grouping column by extracting the first 7 characters (YYYY-MM)
  mutate(
    year_month = substr(date, 1, 7)
    # Example: "2024-01-31" becomes "2024-01"
  ) %>%
  # Group the data by university name and the new month string, then count rides
  group_by(University_Name, year_month) %>%
  summarise(
    total_rides = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
```


```{r}
summary(BostonTStops)
```

```{r}
colnames(BostonTStops)

str(BostonTStops$Lat)
str(BostonTStops$Long)

library(sf)

# Create sf object from T stops
T_stops_sf <- st_as_sf(
  BostonTStops,
  coords = c("Long", "Lat"),  # x = longitude, y = latitude
  crs = 4326
)

# Transform CRS to matc universities dataset
T_stops_sf <- st_transform(T_stops_sf, crs = 2249)


```

```{r}

# Find the index of the nearest T stop for each university
nearest_t_stop_index <- st_nearest_feature(CollegesandUniversities_SF, T_stops_sf)

# Calculate the distance from each university to its nearest T stop (in meters)
distances_to_t_stop_meters <- st_distance(CollegesandUniversities_SF, T_stops_sf[nearest_t_stop_index,], by_element = TRUE)

# Convert to a numeric vector and convert meters to miles
distances_to_t_stop_miles <- as.numeric(distances_to_t_stop_meters) * 0.000621371 

# Add this new distance column to main university data frame
FinalCollegesandUniversities$Distance_to_TStop_miles <- distances_to_t_stop_miles


```


```{r}

final_analysis_data <- left_join(
  rides_per_university_month, 
  FinalCollegesandUniversities, 
  by = "University_Name" 
)

# Verify the result
head(final_analysis_data)

```


```{r}
summary(final_analysis_data)

library(dplyr) 
glimpse(final_analysis_data)

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

average_rides_per_university <- final_analysis_data %>% 
  group_by(University_Name) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_monthly_rides = mean(total_rides, na.rm = TRUE), #
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# This will have one row per university
print(average_rides_per_university)

```

```{r}
final_regression_data <- left_join(
  average_rides_per_university, 
  FinalCollegesandUniversities, 
  by = "University_Name"
)

glimpse(final_regression_data)

```

```{r}
# Code ran previously to get distance values (distances_miles and distances_to_t_stop_miles) 

# Extract unique station locations (using start station info as a proxy)
unique_stations_sf <- bluebike_trips_sf %>%
  group_by(start_station_id) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()

# Find nearest station index and calculate distance (in miles)
nearest_station_index <- st_nearest_feature(CollegesandUniversities_SF, unique_stations_sf)
distances_meters <- st_distance(CollegesandUniversities_SF, unique_stations_sf[nearest_station_index,], by_element = TRUE)
distances_miles <- as.numeric(distances_meters) * 0.000621371 

# Find nearest T stop index and calculate distance (in miles)
nearest_t_stop_index <- st_nearest_feature(CollegesandUniversities_SF, T_stops_sf)
distances_to_t_stop_meters <- st_distance(CollegesandUniversities_SF, T_stops_sf[nearest_t_stop_index,], by_element = TRUE)
distances_to_t_stop_miles <- as.numeric(distances_to_t_stop_meters) * 0.000621371 



# This adds the column to the 1-row-per-university data frame
FinalCollegesandUniversities$Distance_to_BlueBikeStation_miles <- distances_miles
FinalCollegesandUniversities$Distance_to_TStop_miles <- distances_to_t_stop_miles

```

```{r}
# Merge the average ridership with the characteristics data
final_regression_data <- left_join(
  average_rides_per_university, 
  FinalCollegesandUniversities, 
  by = "University_Name"
)

glimpse(final_regression_data)

```
```{r}
# Run the linear model
model <- lm(
  avg_monthly_rides ~ Student_Population + Distance_to_BlueBikeStation_miles + Distance_to_TStop_miles + CITY + TYPE + CATEGORY, 
  data = final_regression_data
)

# View the results of the model
summary(model)

```
```{r}
# The simplified linear model focusing only on core numerical predictors
simplified_model <- lm(
  avg_monthly_rides ~ Student_Population + Distance_to_BlueBikeStation_miles + Distance_to_TStop_miles, 
  data = final_regression_data
)

# View the results of the simplified model
summary(simplified_model)

```

```{r}


library(dplyr)

# Define the months we want to keep (e.g., 06, 07, 08, 09)
peak_months_data <- final_analysis_data %>%
  filter(substr(year_month, 6, 7) %in% c("06", "07", "08", "09"))


average_rides_peak_season <- peak_months_data %>%
  group_by(University_Name) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_monthly_rides_peak = mean(total_rides, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

final_regression_data_peak <- left_join(
  average_rides_peak_season,
  FinalCollegesandUniversities,
  by = "University_Name"
)

peak_model <- lm(
  avg_monthly_rides_peak ~ Student_Population + Distance_to_BlueBikeStation_miles + Distance_to_TStop_miles,
  data = final_regression_data_peak
)

summary(peak_model)
```

```{r}
#Lets visualize what is happening. 

summary(Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths)


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

daily_rides <- Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    total_daily_rides = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

ggplot(daily_rides, aes(x = date, y = total_daily_rides)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +

  ) +

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2) # Make sure ggplot2 is loaded

station_trips_summary <- Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths %>%
  group_by(start_station_id, start_station_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_start_trips = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Sort the stations in descending order of trip count for a more useful chart
  arrange(desc(total_start_trips))


ggplot(station_trips_summary, aes(x = reorder(start_station_name, -total_start_trips), y = total_start_trips)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") + 
  labs(
    title = "Total Bluebikes Trips Started Per Station (2024)",
    x = "Station Name",
    y = "Total Number of Trips Started"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))

#top 20 

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Create the summary table
top_20_stations <- Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths %>%
  group_by(start_station_id, start_station_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_start_trips = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_start_trips)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

# Plot (using coord_flip to avoid label overlap & reorder issues)
ggplot(top_20_stations, aes(x = start_station_name, y = total_start_trips)) +
  geom_col(fill = "dodgerblue4") +
  coord_flip() +   # <— This avoids reorder() problems so bars ALWAYS show
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Most Used Bluebikes Start Stations (2024)",
    x = "Station Name",
    y = "Total Number of Trips Started"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))

```


```{r}
#bottom 20 stations
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

bottom_20_stations <- Bluebikes_2024_AllMonths %>%
  group_by(start_station_id, start_station_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_start_trips = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Sort in ascending order (smallest trips first)
  arrange(total_start_trips) %>%
  # Select only the top 20 rows (which are now the ones with the fewest trips)
  slice_head(n = 20)

ggplot(bottom_20_stations, aes(x = reorder(start_station_name, total_start_trips), y = total_start_trips)) +
  geom_col(fill = "dodgerblue4") +
  labs(
    title = "Bottom 20 Least Used Bluebikes Start Stations (2024)",
    x = "Station Name",
    y = "Total Number of Trips Started"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
```

```{r}
academic_months_data <- final_analysis_data %>%
  filter(substr(year_month, 6, 7) %in% c("01","02","03","04","09","10","11","12"))
average_rides_academic_season <- academic_months_data %>%
  group_by(University_Name) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_monthly_rides_academic = mean(total_rides, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
final_regression_data_academic <- left_join(
  average_rides_academic_season,
  FinalCollegesandUniversities,
  by = "University_Name"
)
academic_model <- lm(
  avg_monthly_rides_academic ~ Student_Population +
    Distance_to_BlueBikeStation_miles +
    Distance_to_TStop_miles,
  data = final_regression_data_academic
)

summary(academic_model)
academic_model_full <- lm(
  avg_monthly_rides_academic ~ 
    Student_Population +
    Distance_to_BlueBikeStation_miles +
    Distance_to_TStop_miles +
    CITY +
    TYPE +
    CATEGORY,
  data = final_regression_data_academic
)

summary(academic_model_full)

academic_data_pred <- final_regression_data %>%
  mutate(predicted = predict(academic_model))


ggplot(academic_data_pred, aes(x = avg_monthly_rides, y = predicted)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkred") +
  labs(
    title = "Actual vs Predicted Rides (Academic Months)",
    x = "Actual Rides",
    y = "Predicted Rides"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#data points are scattered, model isnt good at predicting line
```
```{r}
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)

coef_df <- tidy(peak_model) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")

ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(term, estimate))) +
  geom_point(color = "firebrick") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = estimate - std.error*1.96,
                     xmax = estimate + std.error*1.96),
                 height = 0.2,
                 color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    title = "Coefficient Plot for Full Model",
    x = "Coefficient Estimate (± 95% CI)",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#CI line passing 0 means none of these predictors are meaninful
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

model1_summary <- final_regression_data %>%
  select(avg_monthly_rides, Student_Population,
         Distance_to_BlueBikeStation_miles,
         Distance_to_TStop_miles) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min  = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max  = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model1_summary


```
